title: Atlassian - Marketplace Maintenance Window
text:
Service: Atlassian
Maintenance: Marketplace Maintenance Window
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2024-12-22T06:30:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2024-12-22T09:30:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2024-12-22T09:02:18.576Z: completed - Scheduled maintenance is now complete. The writes operations to Marketplace were stopped for 20 minutes. Now, all the operations are back to normal.
- 2024-12-22T06:30:21.138Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2024-12-22T05:30:21.820Z: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2024-12-19T11:43:18.324Z: scheduled - Marketplace will be undergoing a scheduled maintenance during this time window. We will be in read-only mode during this time.

incident_updates.body: Scheduled maintenance is now complete. The writes operations to Marketplace were stopped for 20 minutes. Now, all the operations are back to normal.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
Marketplace will be undergoing a scheduled maintenance during this time window. We will be in read-only mode during this time.
